<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; require_once ABSPATH.'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
wp_set_current_user(1);
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/');
$map=array();$before=array();
foreach(gpc_pages() as $key=>$def){
 if(in_array($key,array('book-formatting','cover-design','amazon-ads','privacy-policy','terms-of-service'),true))continue;
 $parent=empty($def['parent'])?0:$map[$def['parent']];
 if($key==='connected-catalog')$parent=$map['services'];
 $id=wp_insert_post(array('post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>$def['title'],'post_name'=>$def['slug']?:'home','post_parent'=>$parent,'post_content'=>'['.$def['shortcode'].']','meta_input'=>array('_gpc_page_key'=>$key,'_wp_page_template'=>'gpc-full-page.php')));
 $map[$key]=$id;
 if($key==='home'){update_option('show_on_front','page');update_option('page_on_front',$id);}
 update_option('gpc_page_ids',$map,false);
 $result=gpc_apply_editorial_layout(get_post($id),$key);
 if(!get_post_meta($id,'_gpc_elementor_layout',true))throw new Exception('Native setup failed: '.$key.' '.$result);
 $before[$id]=array('content'=>hash('sha256',get_post($id)->post_content),'native'=>hash('sha256',get_post_meta($id,'_elementor_data',true)));
}
update_option('gpc_form_delivery',array('provider'=>'web3forms','access_key'=>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),false);
$before_delivery=hash('sha256',serialize(get_option('gpc_form_delivery')));
$before_article=get_permalink($map['connected-catalog']);
do_action('admin_init');
$preserved=true;foreach($before as $id=>$data){$preserved=$preserved && $data['content']===hash('sha256',get_post($id)->post_content) && $data['native']===hash('sha256',get_post_meta($id,'_elementor_data',true));}
$report=array('wordpress'=>$GLOBALS['wp_version'],'elementor'=>ELEMENTOR_VERSION,'yoast'=>WPSEO_VERSION,'php'=>PHP_VERSION,'plugin'=>GPC_VERSION,'native_pages_before'=>count($before),'article_before'=>$before_article,'article_after'=>gpc_url('connected-catalog'),'saved_content_preserved'=>$preserved,'original_page_hashes'=>$before,'provider_settings_preserved'=>$before_delivery===hash('sha256',serialize(get_option('gpc_form_delivery'))),'created'=>get_option('gpc_structure_created_pages'),'repair_results'=>get_option('gpc_structure_repair_results'),'routes'=>array());
foreach(gpc_pages() as $key=>$def){$p=gpc_find_page($key);$report['routes'][$key]=array('id'=>$p?$p->ID:0,'url'=>gpc_url($key),'native'=>$p?(bool)get_post_meta($p->ID,'_gpc_elementor_layout',true):false);}
$report['repeat_noop']=!gpc_repair_page_structure();
file_put_contents('/wordpress/qa-result.json',json_encode($report,JSON_PRETTY_PRINT|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES));
flush_rewrite_rules(false);
